title: Tracking acute response of C elegans to cocaine
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xvffn3n

steps.title: Synchronize C. elegans Population
steps.instruction: Prepare synchronized L1 larvae using the bleach method.

substeps.instruction: Chunk WT N2 on 3 maintenance plates.
Bleach the plates after 2 days following the Bleach synchronization of c elegans protocol.
Refeed the starved L1s on 4 different OP50 seeded plates 72 hours prior to the experiment day.
Prepare and pour Low peptone NGM on 35mm imaging plates following the Making low peptone NGM and Plate pouring protocol.
Store plates at 4°C until use.

steps.title: Prepare Cocaine and Control Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5mM cocaine hydrochloride stock solution and control water.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 2.5mg of cocaine hydrochloride in 1471 µl DI water to create a 5mM solution.
Prepare DI water for control plates.

steps.title: Drug Treatment of Plates
steps.instruction: Apply cocaine or water to the imaging plates to achieve a final concentration of 50µM.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 35µl of the 5mM cocaine solution onto 6 (or more) imaging plates (each containing 3.5ml agar).
Pipette 35µl of DI water onto 6 (or more) control plates.
Allow plates to dry under a hood for 1-2 hours.

steps.title: Set Up Imaging Rig and Hardware
steps.instruction: Prepare the physical rig and cleaning.

substeps.instruction: Clean the rectangular glass plate with ethanol and lint-free tissue.
Switch ON the rig.
Align the movable part to the desired position and lock it by pressing ON (use EMO to unlock/relock).

steps.title: Configure Software and Data Folders
steps.instruction: Set up the 3 PCs and GECKO software for recording.

substeps.instruction: Log in to the 3 PCs (Passwords: BehavGenom709; PC 3: BehavGenom710).
Change screen lock time to 20 minutes.
Create a destination folder (PC -> Data Part 1 -> Run script init_exp.ps1) named with the date (e.g., 20181011).
Open GECKO software on each PC and configure: Recording mode to 15 mins, Video format to hdf5, and select the created output folder.
Select 'ALL CAMERA' (for both cameras) or 'CURRENT CAMERA' from the RECORD icon drop-down.

steps.title: Perform Imaging
steps.instruction: Place worms on plates and record video.

substeps.instruction: Use a hair pick to place 5 adult worms onto each imaging plate.
Place plates agar side up with lids off on the rectangular glass plate under the cameras.
Check focus on each camera for each PC.
Start recording immediately.

steps.title: Post-Imaging Data Management
steps.instruction: Shut down equipment and transfer data.

substeps.instruction: Turn OFF the rig and close GECKO.
Run the script to copy data to the network (PC -> Data Part 1 -> Run script move_files_anyPC.ps1).
Change screen lock time back to 1 minute.
Discard the plates.
